$comment: Phone first-load script budgets in KB gzipped, checked by scripts/check-script-budget.mjs after the production build. Set on 16 October 2026 at the measured size plus about 10 KB, and lowered the same day after the rail and search left a phone's first load. Lower a budget when a route shrinks. Raise one only with a reason in the PR. 18 October 2026 (PR #404, owner approval via Grok Bot 17:06 AWST): Home 560 to 563, Referrals 577 to 580 and ED 532 to 535 KB. The stricter executive count-only field lists and the downtime-pack context add about 2-2.5 KB gzipped to the shell every route loads, and main was already at these budgets. 18 October 2026 (PR #412, repo clean-up item 24): Ward 587 to 588 KB. Splitting the oversized ward screen into smaller files means its many values are now passed between components by name, which minifying cannot shorten; measured on this branch at 587.5 KB against main's 586.8 KB. The pieces that the React Compiler started memoising after the split are opted out with "use no memo", so the other routes stay within budget. 19 October 2026 (PR #419, owner approval): Home 563 to 564, Referrals 580 to 581, Ward 588 to 589 and Movements 623 to 624 KB. ED stays at 535. 19 October 2026 (PR #437, owner approval 17:24 UTC): Referrals 581 to 582 KB. Main measured 581.2 KB after #424, #435 and #433 merged together; PR #437 is documentation only. 19 October 2026 (PR #442, audit F-19): ED 535 to 536, Ward 589 to 590 and Movements 624 to 625 KB. The coordinator-only duplicate bed request row joins the shared task list; measured at 535.5, 589.1 and 624.3 KB. 19 October 2026 (coordinator headroom for open PRs): Home 564 to 565, Referrals 582 to 583, ED 536 to 537 and Ward 590 to 591 KB; Movements stays 625. CI on PR #441 measured main at 563.4, 581.2, 535.0, 588.6 and 623.8 KB, local builds read up to 1.5 KB higher, #438 adds about 1.3 KB on the ward page and #442 about 0.5 KB on ED, Ward and Movements. Each raise is 2 KB or less over the 19 October budgets; the real trim is planned in the final styling and size clean-up batch (audit F-11). 19 October 2026 (PRs #442, #443, #445 and #446 on main, then #448 and #454): Home 565 to 567 and Ward 591 to 594 KB. Main CI on 6b7beb03 measured 566.2 and 592.9 KB after the day's merges; #448's one-scroll Home and sticky Placement panel measured 566.4 and 593.0 KB, and #454 adds about 0.4 KB on Ward. Today's raises add up, so the real trim stays on the final styling and size clean-up batch (audit F-11). 20 October 2026 (follow-up trim to #452): Home 567 to 565 and Ward 594 to 591 KB, back to the 19 October budgets. Referrals, ED and Movements are unchanged. 20 October 2026 (PR #457, the trim, merged with #458): Home 565 to 560, Referrals 583 to 564, ED 537 to 533, Ward 591 to 577 and Movements 625 to 620 KB. The Referrals match panel now loads when a referral is chosen, as the shortlist panel does on Home. With #458's banner split and #448's Placement panel, a local build measured 558.5, 561.2, 531.6, 575.6 and 618.1 KB; each budget is that plus about 1 KB, and Referrals keeps about 2 KB for the open referral panels (#449) and shared reducer (#453) PRs.
